'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Noah Dockendorf DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Noah Dockendorf]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (V)]]
* '''Username:''' An_Idea
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
